alternative: Heiress of the House of Gremory

node.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8")
__Rank/Role:__ Top-class devil (Pure devil)/ King
__Power:__ Power of destruction

A 12th grade student and the prettiest girl in the academy. Comes from the old noble of pure devils, the house of Gremory, a top-class devil who is called a genius nicknamed "Crimson Ruin Princess". Her brother is in fact one of the Yondai-Maou, [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/58343). Both of them possess the power of destruction. She revives [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387) as her servant after finding him dead, killed by a fallen-angel and possessing a rare Sacred Gear. Kind and soft to her servants, becomes a totally different person when training or fighting.

~!She begins to develop romantic feelings for Issei in Volume 2 of the light novel and moves in with him at the volume's end.  In Volume 10, he confesses that he loves her and she returns his feelings. They begin dating after that.!~

__Rank:__ Middle-class Devil
__Role:__ Queen
__Race:__ Reincarnated Devil (Former Half-Human/Half-Fallen Angel)
__Power:__ Elemental magic (mainly thunder), Holy Lightning (From Volume 5 onward)


A third-year student and one of the "Two Great Onee-samas" of Kuou Academy along with [Rias](https://anilist.co/character/50389). Called the ultimate "Queen" by other members. Born between a human mother and fallen angel father, after the death of her mother, she became Rias' servant. She is a friend close enough to call Rias by her name in private, yet calls her Buchou in presence of others and displays a master-servant relationship in public. She persistently refuses to use her power of light, inherited from her father, but starts using it after being convinced by [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387).

__Rank:__ Low-class devil (Former nekomata)/Rook
__Power:__ Youjutsu

A 10th grade student. Originally about to be executed by the devils after her sister, [Kuroka](https://anilist.co/character/88080/Kuroka-), kills her own master. The Satan, [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/58343/Sirzechs-Lucifer), protected her, and left her under his sister's, [Rias](https://anilist.co/character/50389/Rias-Gremory)' care - becoming her servant. She refused to use the power of youjutsu because she didn't want to become like her sister. She overcame her power along with [Akeno](https://anilist.co/character/51347/Akeno-Himejima) after [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387/Issei-Hyoudou) made her overcome her own powers. She doesn't show any emotion at all, and says harsh things and hits Issei when he is doing or thinking something perverted. She shows the most concern for her comrades when they are in trouble.

~!At the end of Volume 5 she has warmed up significantly to Issei and even begins sitting on his lap and sneaking into his bed.  After this, she gradually develops romantic feelings towards him.!~

A second-year high school student attending Kuou Academy. He is known to be stupid, lecherous and a pervert among his peers. A normal high school student born in a normal family, but is in possession of the Sacred Gear "Boosted Gear" which is listed as one of the ultimate Sacred Gears (Longinus). He was killed by his first girlfriend, a Fallen Angel, and was revived as a Devil and a servant of Rias Gremory, his new master. Now he aims to become a Harem King by gaining a peerage, unaware of himself attracting girls around him.

name.native: アーシア・アルジェント

node.description:
__Rank:__ Low-class 
__Devil Role:__ Bishop 
__Species:__ Reincarnated Devil (Former human) 
__Sacred Gear:__ Twilight Healing  

A second-year student at Kuou Academy. Originally a sister who was known as a holy maiden due to her healing powers. She was raised in an orphanage and was taken in by the Church after her powers were discovered. However, she was kicked out of the Church for healing a Devil, and was taken in by people affiliated with the Fallen Angels. She starts living with Issei after being saved from the Fallen Angels' grasp. As a person raised in the Church, she lacks common sense.   

~!After she starts living with Issei, she shows that she has feelings for him but he dismisses this as her looking at him like a brother.  When Rias moves in, she becomes increasingly more daring in her attempts to win Issei and views Rias as a rival in spite of their sister-like relationship.  At the end of Volume 6, she kisses Issei and he realizes the true depths of her feelings.!~

__Rank:__ Mid-class devil (Former human)
__Sacred Gear:__ Sword Birth -> Sword of Betrayer (Balance-Break)

An 11th grade student. Self proclaimed best friend of Ise, and the school prince. He was a victim of the "Project: Holy Sword" where he was the only sole survivor. He became Rias's servant when she saved him from death, but still swore the accomplish his revenge to those who treated him as test subjects and disposed his friends. He also harbors a great hatred towards the holy sword Excalibur.

node.description:
[Raiser's](https://anilist.co/character/56665/Phenex-Riser) sister. She is also Raiser's Bishop.

~!She becomes [Issei's](https://anilist.co/character/50387/Hyoudou-Issei) manager and manages his schedule and activities as the Oppai Dragon!~

Her identity was The Fallen Angel, Raynare. The villain who plotted to seduce and than kill Issei using the name, Yuuma Amano, and stole Asia's Sacred Gear, Twilight Healing. Unfortunately, Issei survived and was resurrected as a low-level demon.  

~!A few episodes later, Yuuma was beaten by Issei.!~

He first appeared in volume 2 of the novel.    ~!Also known as the Welsh Dragon or the Sekiryutei (Red Dragon Emperor). One of the Two Heavenly Dragons along with the Vanishing Dragon Albion. The two dragons, with powers rivaling to gods, started fighting a long time ago for reasons even Ddraig forgot.   At that time, the angels, devils and fallen angels were waging a war against each other. The 3 factions believed that the fight the two dragons were having could spell disaster to the whole world so they set aside their war to stop the fight and seal the two dragons.   He now resides inside Issei's Sacred Gear as a result of being sealed in it. !~

name.native: サーゼクス・ルシファー

node.description: Sirzechs Lucifer, formerly known as Sirzechs Gremory, is the older brother of [Rias Gremory](https://anilist.co/character/50389/Gremory-Rias). Known as the Crimson Satan, he is the leader of the Four Great Satans who rule the Underworld with the title of "Lucifer". He is also the husband of [Grayfia Lucifuge](https://anilist.co/character/58345/Lucifuge-Grayfia) and father of their son, [Millicas Gremory](https://anilist.co/character/199906/Gremory-Millicas).

The Vice-President of the Student Council and Souna's Queen. Her relationship with Souna is similar to that of Rias and Akeno. She is the fourth most popular girl in the school. She is a master swordsman who faced against both Yuto and Zenovia on separate occasions during their Rating Game. While she manages to defeat Zenovia, she failed to gain the upper hand against Yuto by sword skills alone. Her Sacred Gear, Mirror Alice , reflects double damage but cannot be summoned twice in a row without a cooldown period.
The student council president of Kuoh Academy, and one of the two top-class devils in the school along with Rias.

Riser's Queen and the strongest member of his peerage, also known as the "Bomb Queen" (爆弾王妃（ボム・クイーン） Bomu Kuīn) due to her powerful fire magic that looks like a bomb explosion when hitting the target.   ~!She defeated Koneko, Akeno (albeit with the use of the Phoenix Tears), and Yuto at the Rating Game between Rias and Riser. She is Riser's favorite piece, as he often makes out with her and fondles her.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

Riser's Rook who is dressed in a Cheongsam. She specializes in Chinese Kung Fu and is able to emit flames on her legs and hands. Incapacitated by Koneko and defeated by Akeno. According to Koneko, her combat abilities as a Rook is on par with a Queen piece.  (Source: Wikipedia)

Matsuda is one of Issei's best friends who made up the "Perverted Trio" (変態三人組 Hentai San'nin-gumi), a trio of the biggest perverts at the Academy, and is a self-proclaimed lolicon. Matsuda's nicknames are "Perverted Baldy" (エロ坊主 Ero-bōzu) and "Sexual Harassment Papparazzi (セクハラパパラッチ Sekuhara Paparatchi). Matsuda is a former jock and school sports star. He and Motohama are jealous of Issei's relationship with the Occult Research Club, and constantly spreads bad rumors about Issei, such as Issei being a sadist who blackmailed Rias and Akeno into doing sexual acts. He does not know that Issei and the Occult Research Club members are Devils.  (Source: High School DxD Wiki)

Kalawarner is a Fallen Angel who allied herself with Raynare in her plot to steal Asia's Sacred Gear.  In the anime, Kalawarner attacked Issei after the latter's first errand as a Devil (visiting one of Koneko's regular clients, Morisawa). Although she had the upper hand, she was forced to retreat when Issei activated his Sacred Gear (in its then-Twice Critical state) for the first time.   Later on, she, along with Dohnaseek and Mittelt, fought against Rias and Akeno during the Occult Research Club's mission to save Asia from Raynare.  ~!She was terminated by Rias' Power of Destruction after making fun of Issei for how he was treated by Raynare (then as Yuuma) on their first date, which provoked Rias.!~ (Source: High School DxD Wiki)

Member of Kuoh Academy's Girls' Kendō Club. She and Murayama are often subjected to Issei, Matsuda, and Motohama's lecherous peeping, in which they and the rest of the club retaliate by beating them with their shinai.

Freed Sellzen is an exiled exorcist who only kills for his own desire. He kills Devils and humans who make contracts with Devils, claiming they are already stained to the extent beyond salvation. He is a wanted criminal at the Vatican. He does not believe in God from the start, as he only wanted to kill monsters. He is a battle-maniac, and prefers violence rather than logic. He is the most hated person to both exorcists and Devils. After being banished by the Orthodox Church, Freed sided with the Fallen Angels in Raynare's plot to steal Asia's Sacred Gear.

Motohama (元浜) is the other best friend of Issei who made up the "Perverted Trio". Motohama has the ability to calculate a female's body measurements just by looking, which earned him nicknames such as "Perverted Glasses" (エロメガネ Ero-megane) and "Three Sizes Scouter" (スリーサイズスカウター Surī Saizu Sukautā). Like Matsuda, he constantly spreads bad rumors about Issei out of jealousy of his relationship with the Occult Research Club. He does not know that Issei and the Occult Research Club members are Devils. Motohama is known to have better results than both Issei and Matsuda.  (Source: High School DxD Wiki)

Member of Kuoh Academy's Girls' Kendō Club, and are anime-exclusive characters. She and Katase are often subjected to Issei, Matsuda, and Motohama's lecherous peeping, in which they and the rest of the club retaliate by beating them with their shinai. They are also in the same class as the Perverted Trio.  (Source: Wikipedia)
Riser's Pawn. Defeated by Yuto.

Mittelt is a Fallen Angel who allied herself with Raynare in her plot to steal Asia's Sacred Gear.  In the anime, she was ordered by Raynare to stand guard at the back of the abandoned Church. She was soon confronted by Rias and Akeno and fought them alongside Kalawarner and Dohnaseek.  ~!She was terminated by Rias' Power of Destruction after making fun of Issei for how he was treated by Raynare (then as Yuuma) on their first date, which made Rias angry.!~ (Source: High School DxD Wiki)
Riser's Pawns. Twin catgirls who specialize in hand-to-hand combat. Defeated by Issei and Yuto.  (Source: Wikipedia)

Riser's Knight dressed in armor and armed with a sword and dagger. Karlamine is a expert swordswoman and is capable of using fire and wind-based attacks and is known as the Knight of Flames (炎の騎士 Honō no Kishi). According to Ravel, she is a sword maniac like Yuto with a similar sense of honor, as she was unhappy that her fellow pieces were used as sacrificial pieces but endures it as it was at Riser's command. She was able to fight on par with Yuto before Issei gains a new ability in the form of the Boosted Gear Gift, where she is defeated by their combination attack.  (Source: Wikipedia)
Riser's Pawns. Twin catgirls who specialize in hand-to-hand combat. Defeated by Issei and Yuto.  (Source: Wikipedia)
Riser's Knight. Wields a giant broadsword that can cause strong winds such as shock waves.   ~!She was defeated by the combination attack of Issei and Yuto.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)
Riser's Pawn. Defeated by Yuto.
Riser's Pawn. Defeated by Yuto.

Riser's Pawn. As a show of power, Riser had her hurt Issei for insulting him and added insult to injury by commenting that despite Mira being his weakest piece, she was able to easily beat Issei.   ~!She later fights Issei again at their masters' Rating Game, where she became one of the first victims of Issei's Dress Break before being completely taken out of the game by Akeno.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

Ile and Nel first appeared in Volume 2 at the Occult Research Club, when Riser is introduces his peerage to Rias after the two of them decide to have a Rating Game. During the Rating Game, they fought against Issei in the replicated gymnasium.   ~!While they initially gained the upper hand by keeping him on his toes, they both lost to him after being one of the first victims (alongside Mira) to be hit by his Dress Break, before being finally taken out of the fight when Akeno destroyed the building.!~ (Source: High School DxD Wikia)

name.native: ライザー・フェニックス

node.description: The third son of the Phenex house, one of the respected families in Hell. He was suppose to marry Rias in an arranged marriage between the Gremory and Phenex family but Issei disagreed and challenged him to a battle. Issei got beaten in one hit by one of his Pawns.  Rias then agreed to have a Rating Game with Raiser to settle the matter of the marriage and get revenge for attacking Issei.   ~!He defeated Rias in the Rating Game by beating up Issei until Rias surrendered. He was then beaten by Issei in the wedding ceremony using a combination of his Balance Breaker and using the Boosted Gear to amplify the effects of holy water and a cross which he brought with him. !~

Riser's Rook. A woman who wears a mask on the right side of her face. She was incapacitated by Issei's Dress Break before being defeated by Issei's Dragon Shot. Unlike Karlamine, she considers honor to be fulfilling Riser's wishes by any means necessary and fair play optional. She reappears in Volume 5 as Ravel's escort during the Young Devils Gathering.  (Source: Wikipedia)

Ile and Nel first appeared in Volume 2 at the Occult Research Club, when Riser is introduces his peerage to Rias after the two of them decide to have a Rating Game. During the Rating Game, they fought against Issei in the replicated gymnasium.   ~!While they initially gained the upper hand by keeping him on his toes, they both lost to him after being one of the first victims (alongside Mira) to be hit by his Dress Break, before being finally taken out of the fight when Akeno destroyed the building.!~ (Source: High School DxD Wikia)
Riser's Bishop. Wears a Kimono. Defeated by Issei and Yuto.

Genshirou Saji is a second-year student at Kuoh Academy. He is the Secretary of Kuoh Academy's Student Council and Sona's Pawn. He is a friend and the direct rival of Issei Hyoudou. He is in love with his master Sona Sitri.  (Source: Highschool DxD Wiki)
Appeared in volume 8 of the novel and episode 6 of the anime. One of Issei's clients in his devil job, an American college student donned in samurai armor who is studying abroad.  (Source: Wikipedia)

A Fallen Angel allied with Raynare, dressed in a trenchcoat and fedora. He was the first Fallen Angel to attack Issei after the latter became a Devil. As a Fallen Angel, he can use his wings to fly and has access to light-based weapons, with the spear of light being his preferred weapon. In the anime, his spear was a light blue color.   ~!He later fought Rias and Akeno but was terminated by them.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)
